mustIssues.why: Self-consistent but wrong join. Each piece is internally consistent (inventory rows well-formed, renderer law stated, cross-renderer parity holds, advisory commands correctly excluded), but the composition yields an authoritative output whose contents a blind implementer cannot reconstruct for half the commands the act names, and DR-G17's qualification harness would be written against exactly this.
